ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet in 407 Morrill Hall. Topic: Biology in Science Fiction Films. Students will be introduced to the span of biological disciplines through the lens of Hollywood science fiction films. Representative films will be viewed in clips or in their entirety to introduce concepts in molecular biology, genetics, anatomy, endocrinology, immunology, pharmacology, plant biology, and entomology. Discussions will focus on the contrast between biological reality and the biological errors made by screenwriters and filmmakers. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
